The problem

Sound familiar?

Lack of motivation isn’t laziness. Our team found three things that keep coming up for students.

Procrastination

You know it’s due. You open it, close it, and “start tomorrow.” Again.

“I’ll do it later.”

No Clear Goals

A big academic goal feels fuzzy, and it’s hard to know what to do first.

“Where do I even begin?”

Overwhelming Workload

Assignments, exams, deadlines and everything else pile up until you freeze.

“It’s just too much.”

Our solution

Meet SugarPill

SugarPill is a prototype app for young adults struggling with motivation. It helps you plan your tasks, see your progress and stay on track, with a little support from other students. We’re not a necessity, but we’re here to help.

ProcrastinationMake it small, then startBreak a task into smaller steps and use the 10-minute timer to begin.
Lack of clear goalsSee what matters today“Today’s Focus” and a progress bar show what’s next and how far you’ve come.
Overwhelming workloadSort it, share it, breatheTasks are ordered by priority, with a Relief Zone for breaks and a Buddy Space for peer support.
